import ast
import functools
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import re
import resource
import sys
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/fast_data/home/liliana/repos@uibcdf/pharmacophoremt")
CASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
label = sys.argv[1]
work = CASE / label
work.mkdir()
os.chdir(work)
original_table = ROOT / "build/phmt-prepared-library-features-20261111-nqdnmeti/source-nm-private/prepared-records.json"
inputs = json.loads(original_table.read_text())
for row in inputs:
    row["path"] = str((ROOT / row["path"]).resolve())
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(row["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == row["sha256"]
(work / "prepared-records.json").write_text(json.dumps(inputs))

import molsysmt as msm
import pharmacophoremt as phmt
from pharmacophoremt import pyunitwizard as puw

if label == "probe":
    row = inputs[0]
    source = msm.h5msm.read(row["path"])
    captured = phmt.modeler.capture_features(source, chemical_state=0)
    result = {"atoms": row["n_atoms"], "features": len(captured["inventory"]["features"])}
else:
    if label == "pm":
        puw.configure.set_standard_units(
            ["pm", "fs", "K", "mole", "dalton", "e", "kJ/mol", "radians"],
            provenance="phmt-screening-application",
        )
    source_doc = ROOT / "docs/content/user/prepared_library_features.md"
    blocks = re.findall(r"```python\n(.*?)```", source_doc.read_text(), re.S)
    assert len(blocks) == 7, len(blocks)
    calls = []
    evaluator = phmt.screening.PoseEvaluator
    original_evaluate = evaluator.evaluate

    @functools.wraps(original_evaluate)
    def observed_evaluate(self, *args, **kwargs):
        calls.append(kwargs.get("pose_id"))
        return original_evaluate(self, *args, **kwargs)

    evaluator.evaluate = observed_evaluate
    namespace = {"__name__": "__recipe__"}
    block_receipts = []
    for number, block in enumerate(blocks):
        compile(block, f"guide:block:{number}", "exec")
        if number == 6:
            with namespace["ScreeningRunView"].open(str(namespace["run_path"])) as view:
                initial = view.progress()
            assert initial["counts"]["committed_work"] == 1 and initial["counts"]["pending_work"] == 3, initial
            before_calls = list(calls)
            namespace["screening_records"][1]["sha256"] = "0" * 64
            try:
                with namespace["PreparedScreeningRun"].open(
                    str(namespace["run_path"]), plan=namespace["plan"],
                    manifest_path=str(namespace["manifest_path"]),
                ) as run:
                    with namespace["closing"](namespace["screening_entries"](namespace["screening_records"])) as entries:
                        with namespace["closing"](run.resume(entries)) as outcomes:
                            list(outcomes)
            except ValueError as error:
                assert str(error) == "Prepared input differs from its receiving record"
            else:
                raise AssertionError("Tampered hash was accepted")
            namespace["screening_records"][1]["sha256"] = inputs[1]["sha256"]
            assert calls == before_calls
            with namespace["ScreeningRunView"].open(str(namespace["run_path"])) as view:
                assert view.progress() == initial
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            exec(compile(block, f"guide:block:{number}", "exec"), namespace)
        block_receipts.append({"block": number, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(block.encode()).hexdigest()})
    assert len(namespace["newly_confirmed"]) == 3
    with namespace["ScreeningRunView"].open(str(namespace["run_path"])) as view:
        outcomes = list(view.results())
        progress = view.progress()
    assert progress["counts"]["committed_work"] == 4 and progress["counts"]["pending_work"] == 0, progress
    assert len(outcomes) == 4 and len(calls) == 4
    for item in outcomes[-2:]:
        assert item["native_result"]["status"] == "matched", item["native_result"]["status"]
        assert item["ranking_score"] == 1
    with namespace["PreparedScreeningRun"].open(
        str(namespace["run_path"]), plan=namespace["plan"],
        manifest_path=str(namespace["manifest_path"]),
    ) as run:
        with namespace["closing"](namespace["screening_entries"](namespace["screening_records"])) as entries:
            with namespace["closing"](run.resume(entries)) as pending:
                assert list(pending) == []
    assert len(calls) == 4
    for row in inputs:
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(row["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == row["sha256"]
    result = {
        "blocks": block_receipts, "initial": initial, "final": progress,
        "tampered_input_refused_before_evaluation": True, "completed_replay_new_evaluations": 0,
        "evaluated_work_keys": calls,
        "outcomes": [{"work_key": o["work_key"], "source_key": o["source_key"],
                      "occurrence_key": o["occurrence_key"], "score": o["ranking_score"],
                      "status": o["native_result"]["status"]} for o in outcomes],
        "input_bytes_unchanged": True,
        "exports": {f: hashlib.sha256((work / f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                    for f in ("screening-outcomes.jsonl", "screening-outcomes.csv")},
        "guide_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source_doc.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    }
result.update({
    "label": label, "python": sys.version, "phmt_runtime_version": phmt.__version__,
    "molsysmt_runtime_version": msm.__version__, "puw_runtime_version": puw.__version__,
    "imports": {m: sys.modules[m].__file__ for m in ("pharmacophoremt", "molsysmt", "pyunitwizard")},
    "unit_policy": puw.configure.report(),
    "native_modules": {n: {"path": str(Path(m.__file__).resolve()),
                           "sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(m.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
                       for n, m in list(sys.modules.items())
                       if n.startswith("molsysmt") and str(getattr(m, "__file__", "")).endswith(".so")},
    "peak_RSS_KiB": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
    "limits": {"DATA": list(resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_DATA)),
               "CPU": list(resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU)),
               "affinity": list(os.sched_getaffinity(0))},
})
(CASE / (label + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"label": label, "passed": True, "peak_RSS_KiB": result["peak_RSS_KiB"]}))

import hashlib
import importlib.abc
import io
import json
import pathlib
import runpy
import sys
from contextlib import redirect_stdout

case = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
label, mode = sys.argv[1:]
work = case / label
blocked = {"pharmacophoremt", "pharmacophoremt_features", "molsysmt",
           "numpy", "scipy", "pyunitwizard", "pint", "ackredit"}

class RefuseScience(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
    def find_spec(self, fullname, path=None, target=None):
        if fullname.split(".")[0] in blocked:
            raise ModuleNotFoundError("Scientific imports unavailable: " + fullname)

sys.meta_path.insert(0, RefuseScience())
forbidden_inputs = json.loads((work / "prepared-records.json").read_text())
forbidden_paths = {row["path"] for row in forbidden_inputs}
attempts = []
def prevent_input_access(event, args):
    if event == "open" and isinstance(args[0], (str, bytes)):
        name = str(args[0])
        if name in forbidden_paths or "prepared-library-features/" in name:
            attempts.append(name)
            raise PermissionError("Original input/feature asset unavailable")
sys.addaudithook(prevent_input_access)
if mode == "cli":
    sys.argv = ["pharmacophoremt_results", str(work / "screening.sqlite3"), "--summary"]
    with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as output:
        try:
            runpy.run_module("pharmacophoremt_results", run_name="__main__")
        except SystemExit as error:
            assert error.code == 0, error.code
    result = json.loads(output.getvalue())
else:
    from pharmacophoremt_results import ScreeningRunView
    with ScreeningRunView.open(str(work / "screening.sqlite3")) as view:
        assert view.query_bytes == (work / "retained-query.json").read_bytes()
        result = view.progress()
        rows = list(view.results())
        assert len(rows) == 4
        view.to_jsonl(str(work / "cold-outcomes.jsonl"))
        view.to_csv(str(work / "cold-outcomes.csv"))
    for first, second in (("screening-outcomes.jsonl", "cold-outcomes.jsonl"),
                          ("screening-outcomes.csv", "cold-outcomes.csv")):
        assert (work / first).read_bytes() == (work / second).read_bytes()
assert result["counts"]["committed_work"] == 4 and result["counts"]["pending_work"] == 0
assert not attempts
assert not (blocked & set(sys.modules))
(case / (label + "-cold-" + mode + ".json")).write_text(
    json.dumps({"mode": mode, "label": label, "progress": result,
                "scientific_imports": [], "forbidden_asset_access": attempts,
                "query_bytes_verified": mode == "python",
                "export_bytes_equal": mode == "python"}, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({"label": label, "mode": mode, "passed": True}))
